details.name: MOB.352_Work_Location_Save
details.message:
`MOB.352` **`Edit Location` saves** — the globe menu's `LocationForm` writes the work stage's
`address`/`x`/`y` (`UPDATE_WORK_STAGE`), proved over `/graphql`, then restored to FIXED values.
- `MOB.348`/`MOB.911` only open the form. This one types a marker location, submits, and asks the
  server; the modal closing is the mutation's `update()` (no optimisticResponse), not the proof.
- Rest: `230 North Alexander Street, New Orleans, LA 70119` · x -90.1025785 · y 29.9782827. Marker: `DD MOB.352 LOCATION SAVE` · x -90.0812 ·
  y 29.9511 (still New Orleans).
- Restore, all `alwaysExecute`: the UI types the rest values back and the server read proves them;
  a backstop sends `updateWorkStage` with the rest values only if the server is not at rest; the
  last read requires rest + status `Ready`.
- Fields are scoped to `#locationform` — the detail page behind has its own `Submit` (trap 3) —
  and cleared through the native setter + `input` event (trap 17).
